sources.title: erikkaum/lattice-retrieval · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: lattice-retrieval is a fast English static embedding model for retrieval. It is a single 30,522 × 1,024 token embedding table with mean pooling: no transformer layers, attention, or contextual token representations.

sources.title: Lattice: an 8 MB static retriever that embeds Wikipedia in 7 minutes
sources.snippet: A Blog post by Erik Kaunismäki on Hugging Face

sources.title: GitHub - ErikKaum/lattice
sources.snippet: Lattice is an end-to-end project for training, quantizing, and serving a static English retrieval model. The final model is a single 30,522 × 1,024 embedding table: tokenize, look up one row per token, mean-pool, and L2-normalize.

sources.snippet: Erik Kaunismäki (@ErikKaum). 4 replies 22 views. Releasing my small summer project Lattice ☀️ Static embedding model that's: - 7.94 MB on disk - embeds the entire English Wikipedia in 7 minutes on my Apple M2 MacBook Air - 0.530 NanoBEIR NDCG@10 Releasing the model and code that I used for training + wrote a small blog 👇
